_comment: TRAVELLING POLICY for the skills-resolver GitHub fallback (.agents/bin/skills_github_fallback.py). Same family and travel mechanism as sca-policy.json: shipped with the kit, editable by each adopting project. Keys are CLOSED — an unknown key or an out-of-set value makes the tool print POLICY INVALID (rc 3), never a silent default.

_keys.install_mode: confirm | auto. confirm (kit default) ARMS the machine gate: install refuses (rc 5) unless --confirmed-by <pilote> is passed, and the resolver stops after search/show and lists the exact install command for the pilote; auto (opt-in per adopting project) vendors validated skills before the human gate without a confirmation.
_keys.top: skills kept and installed per stack. Hard bound is 2 — a higher value is POLICY INVALID.
_keys.licences: closed SPDX allow-set. A null/NOASSERTION spdx_id never matches.
_keys.min_stars: star floor before a candidate is ranked.
_keys.max_age_months: reject a repo whose pushed_at is older than this.
_keys.max_size_kib: reject a SKILL.md larger than this.
